label.description: The text to be displayed on the button, providing a clear and concise indication of the button's purpose or action.

variant.description: The visual style of the button, which can be used to indicate the importance or type of action the button represents.

type.description: The HTML button type attribute, which specifies the behavior of the button when it is clicked.

disabled.description: A boolean that determines whether the button is disabled, preventing user interaction and indicating that the button is not currently available for action.

onClick.description: A function that is called when the button is clicked, allowing for custom behavior to be executed in response to the user's interaction with the button.

href.description: The URL that the button should navigate to when clicked, if the button is used as a link.

isExternal.description: A boolean that determines whether the link should open in a new tab or window, indicating that the destination is external to the current site.

big.description: A boolean that determines whether the button should be displayed in a larger size, making it more prominent and easier to interact with.

inverse.description: A boolean that determines whether the button should be displayed with an inverse color scheme, which can be used to create contrast against a darker background.

leftIcon.description: An object that defines the icon to be displayed on the left side of the button, including the icon's name, size, and any additional styling or attributes.

rightIcon.description: An object that defines the icon to be displayed on the right side of the button, including the icon's name, size, and any additional styling or attributes.

className.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the button component.

style.description: Inline styles to apply to the button component.

children.description: Inner HTML or text to be displayed within the button, allowing for more complex content such as additional elements or formatting.
